old_problem: The source does not include the proprietary Speed Change 15 action or prove that root port, switches/retimers, board/backplane/cabling, endpoint and firmware support Gen5 at the required width. Without trajectory/error rules, a reduced-width or final-only result could be misclassified.
disposition_reason: The requested test is clear and can be safely parameterized: five hundred Gen1-to-Gen5 transitions at expected width/speed without disqualifying errors. The capability dossier, vendor tool/configuration and exact acceptance numbers are Project Configuration. Pending is removed, but the execution gate fails closed if even one channel component lacks approved Gen5/full-width support; no Gen4 downscope or reduced-width PASS is allowed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2104, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2105 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP SW-00004-V003 / 2e3935d5c1f94aed was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
This is the highest-generation Speed Change 15 identity; Gen4/13/12 results do not establish its Gen5 channel or repetition coverage.
Capability evidence must cover every logical and physical element, required lanes/width, firmware settings and the exact path before high-rate cycling.
The versioned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual recipe defines Gen1 start, Gen5 request and allowed equalization/LTSSM path; agent inference is prohibited.
A fail-closed ledger retains all 500 initial/requested/intermediate/settled states, full-width result, enumeration, timestamps, fresh errors and health.
Any unsupported element, Gen4 fallback, reduced width, forbidden equalization path, timeout, new disqualifying AER, reset, endpoint loss or artifact gap stops the loop.
No failing or missing record is replayed into coverage; the first anomaly and approved OOB recovery remain evidence.
No LTSSM/NVQual, Gen1/Gen5 request, equalization, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Explicit-capability Speed Change 15: 500 Gen1-to-Gen5 PCIe transactions
test_case.purpose: Qualify an explicitly certified GB-NV-PVP Gen5/full-width PCIe channel through five hundred atomic Gen1-to-Gen5 training/equalization transactions without downscope, disqualifying errors or platform-health regression.
required_package: Signed Gen5/full-width capability matrix for root port, switch/retimer, physical channel, endpoint/GPU and firmware
Pinned approved Gen5 LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 15 build, command and configuration
Immutable path/lane/width map plus Gen1 start and Gen5 request definition
Allowed equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline, transient and AER/error acceptance
Dedicated SUT, durable 500-entry fail-closed ledger, OOB console, safety aborts and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until complete Gen5 capability and Project Configuration are approved. Preserve full topology/link/error/health baseline; after point authorization execute the exact Speed Change 15 action for ledger entries 1..500. Durably record Gen1 start, Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settled Gen5/full-width state, enumeration, error deltas and platform health before enabling the next transaction. Stop at the first unsupported, reduced, failed or incomplete result; never accept Gen4, clear evidence or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All channel components are certified for the target and every one of 500 unique transactions reaches Gen5 at the required width through an allowed equalization trajectory within deadline; endpoint/siblings and platform health remain valid with no disqualifying new error, reset or safety event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without a signed end-to-end Gen5 capability dossier and exact tool/oracle. Thereafter PASS requires 500 complete clean full-width Gen5 transactions. FAIL on unsupported component, Gen4/reduced-width settlement, trajectory/timeout failure, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing configuration/artifact is BLOCKED and no replay may replace it.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until explicit Gen5/full-width capability, Speed Change 15 recipe, trajectory/error oracle, interlock and recovery are approved.
Use a dedicated lab SUT with stable cooling/power, OOB console and immediate human authorization.
Preserve every raw transaction and all existing error evidence; fail closed before the next request.
Stop without retry on capability mismatch, downscope, equalization/link/device failure, new error/reset, evidence loss or safety excursion.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner/lab authorization and pinned tool/configuration
End-to-end Gen5 capability/firmware/physical-channel dossier and path/lane/width map
Signed Gen1/Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM, deadline/transient/error contract
Raw monotonic 1..500 ledger containing complete initial/intermediate/settled full-width states and timestamps
First-fault/OOB recovery or clean final Gen5 topology/health, no-downscope/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported capability, Gen4 fallback/reduced width, failed equalization/settle, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap, interlock the loop and preserve that record. Do not alter target or retry. Use signed OOB recovery and quarantine the path if Gen5/full-width topology and health cannot be restored.
